verdict.rationale: Martin's docs say users can phone him and talk with him. He is reachable by phone, can be told to 'note down everything we talked about on this call', and can place scheduled wake-up calls, so he delivers a voice conversation channel. The docs imply but do not detail how natural or responsive these conversations are. Missing for 10: documentation of conversational quality and latency (natural turn-taking, interruptions), any in-app or desktop voice mode beyond phone calls, and independent hands-on corroboration of the voice experience.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can have a natural, real-time voice conversation with the assistant

citations.quote: Call Martin and say "Note down everything we talked about on this call and call it 'Brain Dump'."
Martin is reachable through all your communication channels, including phone, SMS, WhatsApp, email, and Slack.
Martin can call you at a specific time every morning to wake you up with the weather and your schedule.
